rule: for each patient iterate I0 <- I0 * (std/target)^2 on up to 12 liver slices until within 3 %, then simulate all slices; the I0 and its history are in each patient's meta.json
why: with one fixed I0 the added liver noise ranged 32-686 HU over the 51 patients (patient and pixel size); real scanners modulate exposure, and the Mayo patients span only 37-62 HU
